metadata.purpose: Precessional timeline and World Ages overview

data.title: The Precessional Timeline
data.description: History structured by the 25,920-year precession cycle, divided into twelve World Ages of approximately 2,160 years each.

precession.explanation: Earth's axis slowly wobbles like a spinning top, causing the spring equinox sunrise to shift backward through the zodiac over millennia. This 'precession of the equinoxes' was known to ancient astronomers and forms the basis for the World Ages.

currentPosition.significance: The Age of Aquarius is prophesied as the era of revelation, scientific awakening, and humanity's coming of age.

worldAges.name: Age of Capricorn
worldAges.significance: The Elohim discover Earth and begin planning the creation project.

worldAges.name: Age of Sagittarius
worldAges.significance: Earth is prepared to support complex life.

worldAges.name: Age of Scorpio
worldAges.significance: Vegetation and plant life are genetically engineered.

worldAges.name: Age of Libra
worldAges.significance: Animals are created to populate the prepared ecosystems.

worldAges.name: Age of Virgo
worldAges.significance: Humans are created 'in the image' of the Elohim.

worldAges.name: Age of Leo
worldAges.significance: The great flood destroys most of humanity; survivors restart civilization.

worldAges.name: Age of Cancer
worldAges.significance: Human civilization rebuilds in the post-diluvian world.

worldAges.name: Age of Gemini
worldAges.significance: Humanity spreads across the Earth; languages and cultures diversify.

worldAges.name: Age of Taurus
worldAges.significance: Great civilizations arise with bull symbolism (Apis, Mithras precursors).

worldAges.name: Age of Aries
worldAges.significance: The age of the Patriarchs; ram sacrifice replaces bull worship.

worldAges.name: Age of Pisces
worldAges.significance: The age of Christ and Christianity; fish as sacred symbol.

worldAges.name: Age of Aquarius
worldAges.significance: The current age of awakening; humanity learns its true origins.
